name: Writing on the concept of the soul

mentions.name: Writing on the concept of the soul
mentions.description: A writing and inquiry project on soul cultivation and the structure of the soul, defining the soul as the part of a person that is the observer. The work includes writing on the topic, probing how people conceptualize the soul, making drawings of the soul, and asking others to draw what they think a soul looks like.
mentions.problem: The topic of the soul is surprisingly under-discussed and under-explored relative to how impactful it is, and concepts like the soul become so overloaded that disambiguating and clarifying what is meant is a challenge.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been thinking a lot about soul cultivation as a concept, and the general structure of the soul, and doing a bit of writing on the topic.

evidence.value: I've been thinking a lot about soul cultivation as a concept, and the general structure of the soul, and doing a bit of writing on the topic.
